name: Ushigome Haruki
source:
"You see, I want to go back to the things that we were before."

Obsession x Separation

Heroine's classmate. Including heroine's best friend Akina, the three of them were a good friends during in middle school. 

A former member of soccer club who used to be athletic , but had to retire due an accident. With a certain incident happened in the past, his relationship with heroine has gone awkward. 

While he's kind and friendly to anyone, there is something dark within him.
